purpose: Unselected art-direction concepts for The Isle

variants.title: Klare Comic-Linien
variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: art-direction proposal for the isometric comic adventure game "The Isle".
Draw a landscape in-game art concept, wide landscape composition, high quality.
Scene: a floating rocky island harbor above a vast cloud sea; two smaller floating islands in the distance and a distinct vertical opening in the cloud sea below the harbor hinting at a passage to a deeper world layer. Wooden docking gantries, a few compact harbor buildings, cargo crates and flags bent by the wind.
Subject: one clearly readable modular exploration zeppelin approaching the dock, full ship visible, elongated gas envelope, suspended gondola, attached cargo pod, visible side-mounted engine pods and a small navigation cabin. A couple of tiny crew silhouettes provide scale.
Camera: elevated isometric orthographic three-quarter gameplay camera, no perspective horizon, game-scale objects and clear silhouettes, not a cinematic poster. Same subject and scene for every art-direction proposal.
Constraints: original designs, no text, no labels, no logo, no watermark, no HUD. Emphasize floating islands, clouds, modular ship silhouette and visually readable play space. This is a standalone concept illustration, not a contact sheet.
Style/medium: Franco-Belgian ligne-claire adventure comic: very clean continuous ink outlines of uniform weight, carefully simplified geometry, flat color areas with restrained cel shadows, airy blue sky tones and warm harbor accents. Crisp economical detail, playful but grounded engineering. Predominantly a hand-drawn 2D comic look.
